# Mongolia

Values for an OG-Core calibration, then the estimates behind them. How to use them: [calibration guide](../calibration-guide.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −0.28, by age as below | MICS 2018, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −0.50 | MICS 2018, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | −1.26 (95% prediction interval −2.00 to −0.52) | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) at GDP per capita (PPP, constant 2021 international $) of $17,773 (2025, World Bank) |
